props.title: Insurance: Finding the Right Partner for the Story
props.subtitle: Insurance marketing and communications
props.challengeSummary: You're asking about insurance experience. Here is what we can point to in our portfolio.

props.title: Find the Story Inside the Data
props.content: In financial services, we'd start by deciding the one thing the numbers need to say, then design every visual to carry that message instead of just displaying data.

props.title: AIG: When Stakes Are High: Reintroducing AIG to the Market
props.summary: We worked with AIG's C-suite over a two-month sprint on the keynote visual design system, hundreds of slides, and event branding for their first Investor Day in over a decade.

props.title: Android Enterprise: Hyper-Targeted Consideration Campaign
props.summary: We built a consideration campaign for Android Enterprise aimed at financial services, with content for sub-sectors including insurance: a 16-page eBook, a research-driven blog post, and promotional social posts.

final.explanation: AIG is our direct insurance work, built around turning complex financials into a clear story. The Android Enterprise campaign is adjacent: it targeted financial services broadly, with insurance as one of its sub-sectors. For you, we'd start by pinning down who needs persuading, whether investors, customers or partners, because that decides what the story has to do.
